runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 07:34 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade role passed ranking, language, trust/economics, competition and locality gates, so jobs-data.json remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. Upwork surfaced two relevant worldwide e-commerce/customer-support VA roles: 8-9 USD/h with 50+ proposals and a client showing 226 hires but only 4.3k USD total spend, plus a 7-8 USD/h role with 20-50 proposals and a client showing 292 hires but only 6.2k USD total spend. Both fit tasks well but have weak spend-per-hire economics and heavy competition, so they were not promoted. A longer-term WooCommerce-favorable project-coordinator role pays only 3-5 USD/h and already has 14 interviews. LinkedIn re-exposed SupportYourApp remote technical support requiring English C1. Reddit public results were stale or supply-side; Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verified hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance client spend-per-hire quality gate
developmentChanges.reason: For Upwork/Freelancer-style clients, calculate total historical spend divided by hires and flag extreme low-spend/high-hire accounts before promotion. This catches apparently active clients whose hiring history suggests microtasks, churn or systematically low realized earnings even when the advertised hourly rate looks acceptable.

developmentChanges.title: Remote hourly floor after fees and FX
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize freelance hourly offers to estimated EUR after platform fee, FX friction and realistic unpaid admin/application time. Use the effective hourly floor as a promotion signal so low-value remote gigs do not consume time merely because they match WordPress, e-commerce or customer-support keywords.
